stories.title: How existing investment structures could help close SA’s infrastructure funding gap
stories.snippet: SA’s infrastructure financing gap remains a major constraint on growth: while the National Development Plan targets fixed investment of 30% of GDP by 2030, actual investment is closer to 14%, despite an estimated R10-trillion in domestic savings. By adapting proven investment vehicles such as REITs to accommodate qualifying infrastructure assets, SA could unlock local capital more effectively, channelling long-term savings into critical infrastructure while leveraging existing regulatory, tax and market frameworks.
